description: This file defines a Scala case class V1Table implementing a catalog v2 Table interface to expose v1 table metadata, along with associated object methods and a fallback trait. It manages table properties, schema, partitioning, and capabilities within Spark SQL's catalog system.

classes.name: V1Table
classes.description: Implementation of catalog v2 Table to expose v1 table metadata, managing properties, schema, partitioning, and capabilities.

classes.name: V2TableWithV1Fallback
classes.description: Trait for a V2 table with fallback support to a V1 table, used when V2 capabilities are not implemented.

methods.name: addV2TableProperties
methods.description: Constructs a map of V2 table properties from a V1 CatalogTable, including type, location, provider, and owner info.

methods.name: getV2TableType
methods.description: Determines the V2 table type string based on the V1 CatalogTable's type.
